title: sm_86 SOL-ExecBench shrink-to-fit provenance stamp
description: Emitted by tools/local_labels/sol_shrink_calculator.py per host-capacity SOL cell. Records the native shape, the regime vector, the chosen fitting shape (if any), and the typed classification. shape_adjusted is provenance (native_predictive true), reduced_representative carries regime_flags (native_predictive false), unavailable::oom_shape_gated records the nearest miss, native_captured_via_replay_mode skips the shrink. Rule 1: geometry inputs only, no NCU metric.
